IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: tenant=BrightLane SLA breach detected (error-rate=12.7%, window=5m). Trigger: tenant-check-high-error-rate. Pager=high. Links: https://observability/redwood/alerts/1923456789 
Miguel (oncall): ack. I’m looking. Any recent deploys for BrightLane?
Riley (product): not from product side, no pushes in the last 24h. They did ask for a config push to their healthcheck agent yesterday but ops confirmed it didn't roll.
Ava (oncall-2): I’m grabbing logs from the gateway, will paste any obvious 5xx patterns.
Miguel (oncall): fwiw, these are tenant-specific healthcheck alerts — we've seen chatter before when tenant-side infra misreports. Could be noisy checks.
Ava (oncall-2): kubectl logs -n prod gateway-abc | grep "BrightLane" | tail -n 200
```
[2026-03-15T12:01:03Z] upstream 502 for /health-check from 10.4.2.9
[2026-03-15T12:01:07Z] upstream 502 for /health-check from 10.4.2.9
[...many repeats...]
```
Deepa (sre): pattern looks like a flapping IP back-end inside BrightLane. The rate of 502s is high but localized to their healthcheck path. Are we paging on per-tenant single-endpoint error rate?
Miguel (oncall): yes, rule is per-tenant error-rate > 5% over 5m. That’s probably too low for noisy customer checks.
Kai (platform): we added that rule last quarter to catch regressions, but it wasn't tenant-aware for noise. We can patch the rule to ignore `/health-check` or raise threshold for tenant-level.
Ava (oncall-2): short term: can we silence the pager for this alert for BrightLane only? I can add a routing rule to suppress paging while leaving the metric on.
Miguel (oncall): please do. Also create a dashboard panel for tenant error-rate by path so product/SEs can see impact.
Ava (oncall-2): creating a silence: /alert-manager silence add --alert tenant-check-high-error-rate --matcher tenant=BrightLane --until 2026-03-15T13:30:00Z --note "temp suppress while contacting customer"
IncidentBot: Silence created (id=silence-7362). Pager notifications suppressed for BrightLane until 2026-03-15T13:30:00Z.
Riley (product): I’ll ping BrightLane to confirm they aren't rolling infra and ask them to check the backend nodes.
Deepa (sre): long term we should: 1) exclude /health-check endpoints from tenant error-rate alerts, or 2) use a higher threshold (e.g., 15%) or a 15m window. I prefer excluding health-checks since they’re often flaky and not user-facing.
Kai (platform): agree. Proposed change: add path filter to rule and bump tenant threshold to 15% for paths that are not high-value. Also add a new split rule: pages only if error-rate on non-health paths >5%.
Miguel (oncall): sounds good. Can someone open a tracking ticket and a small RFC for the rule change? Label: oncall-silence-followup, priority P2.
Ava (oncall-2): creating ticket: https://jira/redwood/browse/OPS-4521 - "BrightLane: tenant healthcheck noise -> alerting rule refinement". Added assignees Deepa and Kai, linked to silence.
Deepa (sre): I’ll prototype the rule change. Quick patch:
```
alert: TenantHighErrorRate
expr: sum(rate(requests_total{tenant=~"$tenant",status=~"5..",path!~"/health-check"}[5m])) / sum(rate(requests_total{tenant=~"$tenant",path!~"/health-check"}[5m])) > 0.15
for: 5m
```
Miguel (oncall): nice. We should also add a migration for existing tenants: add BrightLane to a temporary watchlist so we get a less noisy view while we tune.
Riley (product): product asks we also generate a per-tenant impact email template so PMs can notify customers if we change threshold for their checks. I'll draft one.
Miguel (oncall): handoff: I need to head offline in ~20m. Ava you good to own follow-ups?
Ava (oncall-2): yep, taking over. Summary: Silence in place, ticket OPS-4521 created, Deepa/Kai working on rule patch, product will contact BrightLane. I’ll keep channel updated. :white_check_mark: 
Deepa (sre): will post a PR once ready. Also will add an observability panel: "Tenant error-rate (non-health) by path" and a short-runbook step to check for multizone backends.
Ava (oncall-2): quick note — adding a temp dashboard link: https://observability/redwood/dashboards/tenant-brightlane-noise
Miguel (oncall): thanks team. If noise recurs after patch we escalate to infra + customer success for a joint call.
IncidentBot: NOTE: Followup tasks created: OPS-4521 (alert tuning), silence-7362, dashboard-1287.
Riley (product): pinged BrightLane via support: they replied "investigating backend flapping, rolling a fix". Will keep you posted.
Ava (oncall-2): latest check: error-rate fell to 2.1% after a restart on BrightLane side. I’m going to close the silence early: /alert-manager silence remove silence-7362
IncidentBot: Silence removed (id=silence-7362). Paging restored for tenant-check-high-error-rate.
Deepa (sre): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/2291 — adds path filter + threshold change, includes tests.
Ava (oncall-2): will monitor for 30m then mark OPS-4521 ready for review.
Miguel (oncall): handing final context to Ava in the ticket. thanks all, leaving channel. :wave:
